rls_test_plan.name: Tenant A Read Own Data
rls_test_plan.description: Tenant A issues C2 operation; queries encounters and interpretations belonging to Tenant A; records return successfully
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: Query returns Tenant A rows; row count > 0; tenant_id matches Tenant A UUID

rls_test_plan.name: Tenant A Cannot Read Tenant B Data
rls_test_plan.description: Tenant A attempts to query an encounter or interpretation record created by Tenant B; PostgreSQL RLS policy filters rows
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: Query returns 0 rows; 404 ENCOUNTER_NOT_FOUND or INTERPRETATION_NOT_FOUND returned; no data leaked

rls_test_plan.name: Tenant A Write Own Data
rls_test_plan.description: Tenant A executes publishNotification, recordInterpretation, and executeSecondaryAction; all Stage-0 tables accept writes
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: INSERT succeeds; rows created in universal_audit_logs, physician_diagnostic_interpretations, and clinical_orders with Tenant A tenant_id

rls_test_plan.name: Tenant A Cannot Write Tenant B Record
rls_test_plan.description: Tenant A attempts to mutate or create a downstream clinical order with Tenant B tenant_id; RLS WITH CHECK policy rejects write
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: PostgreSQL throws SQLSTATE 44000 (new row violates row-level security policy for table clinical_orders); transaction aborts

rls_test_plan.name: CS82 Remediated Downstream Order Insert
rls_test_plan.description: executeSecondaryClinicalAction creates downstream clinical_orders row; tenant_id is explicitly supplied and matches active UoW tenant
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: INSERT INTO clinical_orders succeeds; tenant_id is non-null and matches Tenant A; no NOT NULL constraint violation

rls_test_plan.name: Transaction Rollback on Error
rls_test_plan.description: Induced error during secondary action execution after order insertion; verifies atomic rollback of clinical_orders and actions
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: PostgreSQL ROLLBACK executed; no partial rows remain in clinical_orders, diagnostic_secondary_actions, or universal_audit_logs

rls_test_plan.name: Connection Reuse Cleanliness
rls_test_plan.description: Socket used for Tenant A request is returned to pool and subsequently leased for Tenant B request; tests DISCARD ALL cleanliness
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: Tenant B request cannot access Tenant A GUCs or data; current_setting('app.current_tenant_id') reflects Tenant B

rls_test_plan.name: Missing Tenant Context Rejection
rls_test_plan.description: HTTP request submitted to C2 routes without x-tenant-id header or req.user.tenantId; controller intercepts request
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: HTTP 403 Forbidden with TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; zero database queries dispatched

rls_test_plan.name: Invalid Tenant Context Rejection
rls_test_plan.description: HTTP request submitted with malformed or non-UUID tenant identifier ('tenant-123'); controller validates UUID
rls_test_plan.expected_evidence: HTTP 403 Forbidden with TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; zero database queries dispatched
